theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+1.57%) and Energy (+0.93%) led the market today, while Health Care (-3.44%) and Consumer Discretionary (-2.36%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.18%, defensives -1.20%, and value/cyclicals -0.32% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.33%, Dow -1.02%, Nasdaq -0.09% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.17%. The VIX rose 0.72% to 15.41, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.72% to $4,444.50, crude oil was little changed at $92.36, and bitcoin slipped 0.32% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
